# PeakGG

> PeakGG is a competitive Valorant platform for European players: ranked Open Cups, team tournaments, Peak League, free agents, scrims and the Peak rank system.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of PeakGG — competitive Valorant, tournaments, ranks and teams.
- [About](/about): Mission, story and values behind PeakGG, built in Brussels.
- [Tournaments](/tournaments): Open Cup solo queue, Challenger Series and Peak Championship tiers.
- [Peak League](/leagues): Europe's competitive Valorant league for permanent teams.
- [Teams](/teams): Browse and join competitive Valorant teams.
- [Free Agents](/free-agents): Players looking for a team and teams recruiting.
- [Scrims](/scrims): Practice matches between teams (no ELO impact).
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top ranked players by Peak ELO.
- [ELO Explained](/elo-explained): How the PeakGG dynamic ELO system works.
- [Aim Guide](/aim-guide): Aim training guide with per-game setups.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about PeakGG.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the PeakGG team.
